description: This file defines the `SourceGenerator` class used for generating Java source files from ASM bytecode representations, filtering out private members, and writing stub class sources.

classes.name: SourceGenerator
classes.description: A helper class for generating Java source files from class bytecode, primarily used for creating stub implementations for Android classes.

methods.name: generateSource
methods.description: Generates Java source files for a set of classes filtered to exclude private members, writing output to specified directory.

methods.name: createWriter
methods.description: Creates a FileWriter for the specified class name within the base directory, ensuring parent directories exist.

methods.name: classNameToJavaPath
methods.description: Converts a fully qualified Java class name into a filesystem path for source file output.

methods.name: visitClassSource
methods.description: Uses ASM ClassReader to accept a chain of ClassVisitors to generate source code.
